attributes.name: Clockwork Magpie
attributes.powers:
You may use any skill in your check to acquire this item; roll 1d12 to determine the difficulty of the check. If you fail to acquire this card, bury a card.

Shuffle this card into your deck to add 1d12 to your check; the difficulty of the check is increased by 1d12. If you fail the check, banish this card.
